providers.title: Supporting potentials
providers.scope: If c >= u(x1)+u(x2)+u(x3) on U^3 with mu(U) = 1, u bounded, and some coupling is carried by the equality set, then the Kantorovich value is 3 times the integral of u, and every optimal coupling is carried by the equality set.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Mass imbalance (OpenAI, after Gerolin, Kausamo and Rajala)
providers.scope: For mu = nu/3 + (1/6) sum of four branch images with disjoint supports, no measure-preserving Borel map selects a branch at almost every central point.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: No Monge optimizer
providers.scope: A supporting potential whose contact set offers only the four branches above each central point excludes every Monge optimizer.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Smooth implicit and inverse functions
providers.scope: Implicit functions and local inverses of smooth maps are smooth.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Jets of the Riesz cost
providers.scope: Hessian of |b|^-s with eigenvalues s(s+1)|b|^(-s-2) and -s|b|^(-s-2); at (0, a_k, -a_k) the cost is 2 + 2^-s, the x-gradient vanishes and the z-gradient is s(1 + 2^(-s-1)) a_k.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A local branch (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Near each triple (0, a_k, -a_k) there are diffeomorphisms X_k, Z_k and a smooth w_k with c >= u_0(x) + w_k(y) + v_k(z), equality exactly at x = X_k(y), z = Z_k(y).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A potential on five balls (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A bounded continuous potential on five small balls supports the Riesz cost with contact set exactly the permutations of the two branch families.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The common ball
providers.scope: On a ball B around 0 the maps Y_k = X_k^-1 and W_k = Z_k Y_k are diffeomorphisms onto disjoint open sets.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The density
providers.scope: mu = nu/3 + (1/6) sum of the four images of nu has a smooth compactly supported density with smooth square root.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: No Monge optimizer for Riesz costs (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For every d >= 2 and s > 0, in particular for the Coulomb cost on R^3, the three-marginal minimum for mu is finite and attained, but every pair of measure-preserving Borel maps costs strictly more.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Uniform variables
providers.scope: If R has a continuous distribution function F, then F(R) is uniform on [0,1].
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Quantiles
providers.scope: For a continuous distribution function, the rational quantile q satisfies q(u) <= t iff u <= F(t), so q(U) has distribution function F.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Rosenblatt's transform
providers.scope: Successive conditional distribution functions send a density on R^d to the uniform measure on the cube.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Borel transport
providers.scope: Any two Borel probability measures with densities on R^d are related by a Borel map Q with Q#alpha = beta.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Splitting into prescribed masses
providers.scope: A Borel set is a disjoint union of slabs of prescribed masses for a measure with a density.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Monge plans approach the minimum (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For the density of the second lesson, measure-preserving Borel maps come within every epsilon > 0 of the Kantorovich minimum without attaining it.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
